healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Validate an EmailOctopus API key by reading the first page of lists on API v2.

lists.list.title: Get all lists
lists.list.description: Retrieve every mailing list in the EmailOctopus account with cursor pagination.

lists.get.title: Get list
lists.get.description: Retrieve one mailing list by ID, including fields, tags, counts, and opt-in settings.

lists.create.title: Create list
lists.create.description: Create a mailing list with the default Email, First name, and Last name fields.

lists.update.title: Update list
lists.update.description: Rename an existing EmailOctopus mailing list.

lists.delete.title: Delete list
lists.delete.description: Permanently delete a mailing list and its contacts. Lists emailed in the last 7 days cannot be deleted.

contacts.list.title: List contacts
contacts.list.description: Retrieve paginated contacts from a list, optionally filtered by tag, status, and date range.

contacts.get.title: Get contact
contacts.get.description: Retrieve one contact by UUID or MD5 of the lowercase email address.

contacts.create.title: Create contact
contacts.create.description: Create a contact on a mailing list with email, optional fields, tags, and status.

contacts.upsert.title: Create or update contact
contacts.upsert.description: Create a contact if missing, otherwise update email, fields, tags, or status.

contacts.unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe contact
contacts.unsubscribe.description: Set a contact's status to unsubscribed while keeping the contact record.

contacts.delete.title: Delete contact
contacts.delete.description: Permanently delete a contact from a list by UUID or MD5 of the lowercase email.

contacts.batch.title: Batch update contacts
contacts.batch.description: Update many contacts on a list in one request. Each contact must include an id.

fields.create.title: Create field
fields.create.description: Create a custom text, number, or date field on a mailing list.

fields.update.title: Update field
fields.update.description: Update a custom field's label, tag, type, or fallback. Path uses current_tag.

fields.delete.title: Delete field
fields.delete.description: Permanently delete a custom field from a mailing list by field tag.

tags.list.title: List tags
tags.list.description: Retrieve paginated tags defined on a mailing list.

tags.create.title: Create tag
tags.create.description: Create a tag on a mailing list for contact segmentation.

tags.update.title: Update tag
tags.update.description: Rename an existing tag. new_tag is sent as the official tag body field.

tags.delete.title: Delete tag
tags.delete.description: Delete a tag from a mailing list.

campaigns.list.title: Get recent campaigns
campaigns.list.description: Retrieve a paginated list of recent EmailOctopus campaigns.
